name: What minor updates can I do to improve my home's value without major renovation?

mainEntity.name: What minor updates can I do to improve my home's value without major renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Minor updates can significantly improve your home's appeal without extensive cost or effort. These include fresh paint in neutral colors, updating light fixtures and hardware, decluttering and depersonalizing spaces, improving landscaping, and deep cleaning. These cost-effective changes help buyers see the home as well-maintained and move-in ready. Kelby Contreras guides clients on identifying these high-impact, low-cost improvements that resonate with buyers in areas like Pinecrest and Sunny Isles Beach.
acceptedAnswer.description: Minor updates like fresh paint, updated fixtures, decluttering, improved landscaping, and deep cleaning can boost your home's value without major renovation. These cost-effective changes appeal to buyers.
